scope: Manufacturer-level electrical capabilities for nine digital/MCU/RF/codec groups: 245 verified physical PCB pad types out of 252 materialized pads. Seven uncertain pad types are omitted from pins and recorded in unresolved, never counted as verified passive placeholders. Not configuration-aware, not production ERC acceptance. On-module antenna receptacles without carrier PCB pad numbers are outside this physical-pad map. Unresolved entries are review gates, not implicit approvals.

unresolved: Pad31 XOUT is omitted from pins because its ERC direction is unresolved. The manufacturer table calls both crystal terminals Analogue(XOSC); evaluate a dedicated oscillator-pair rule rather than count a passive placeholder as verified coverage.
Endpoint policy must preserve actual QSPI bus electrical capability while forbidding unwanted external loads; broad QSPI_* no-connect matching must never capture the supply.
Power reachability must model VREG_LX through its inductor only when VREG_VIN and VREG_AVDD are supplied; a power_out label alone does not prove a powered core.
